family.description: This domain is found in GSK3-beta interaction protein (GSKIP), which binds to GSK3beta [[cite:PUB00054079]]. It is also found as a short domain towards the N terminus in clustered mitochondria protein, also known as clueless in Drosophila, which is involved in proper cytoplasmic distribution of mitochondria [[cite:PUB00064791],[cite:PUB00068099],[cite:PUB00068100]].
family.name: GSKIP domain
